svg.text: Schematic candidate — no native PCB, routing or fabrication release
A:142 sites / B:143 sites / each 11 scan rows x up to13 sinks
13 x 20mA each driver: 0.52A combined peak; 3mA initial setting
Front 2.4x0.9mm land/body envelope; max R27.4438 < aperture R28.5
33 rear components; nominal mated GH + pad envelope included
Max R21.6172 < reserved R28; lowest Z-7.45 > reserved Z-10
Dashed boxes: optional 4x4mm no-component thermal patches
All dimensions in mm. Back is projected through PCB in HEAD coordinates, not a back-side assembly view.
GH catalogue references only; wire bends, latch/tool travel, tolerances, thermal bridge and fabrication stack remain unverified.
Original drawing: Auromix contributors / CC BY-NC 4.0
